high: Gather-phase answer leakage: opening a vital adds memo text explicitly saying 「高い」「低い」「速い」, while the normal blood-pressure row adds no clue. A player can therefore flag exactly the three memo-producing vital rows without comparing any displayed value with its normal range.

Failure has no gameplay cost or visual/world consequence. Incorrect reports only produce a text prompt and preserve the complete selection state, allowing unlimited enumeration of the 16 possible four-row flag sets.

The case, row order, abnormal set, and results are fixed. After one play, the invariant strategy “flag the first three rows” wins without reading case-specific data, so C_required is not robust and replay/mastery collapse into memorization.
medium: ASK and EXAM context does not affect the review judgment or outcome; it serves only as a clue-count gate. This weakens the claimed authentic task of integrating multiple clinical sources.

The central loop is closer to fixed-data worksheet checking than a game: gather fixed disclosures, classify four fixed rows, receive text-only rejection, and retry. There is little strategy, variation, escalation, or observable patient-world feedback.

The blood-pressure presentation is internally ambiguous: 128/78 is marked normal against 「だいたい120/80くらい」 rather than a defined range. That makes the stated exact comparison rule less clear for children.
low: The `.vital-row.off` CSS rule still exists, contrary to the suggestion that it was removed, although ClueBoardGame never applies the `off` class and therefore does not currently leak through color.

`MIN_TOOLS` is vacuous for the current fixed dataset: ASK supplies at most four clues, EXAM two, and VITALS three, so reaching `MIN_CLUES = 5` already necessarily uses at least two tools. It could matter only if future content changes.
The failure copy 「もう一度、数字とふつうの範囲を見比べてみよう。」 is supportive and not punitive. It repeats the already-stated task rather than revealing a particular correct row.

src/q1/ClueBoardGame.tsx:142 — EXAM interactions likewise affect only gathering progress, not the final judgment.

factory/state/audits/audit-summary.md:53 — the original defect was content-blind five-clue completion; the new validator adds a judgment screen but the memo and fixed-position shortcuts still permit content-blind success.
recommended_actions: Remove evaluative words such as 「高い」「低い」「速い」 from gather-phase memo clues and give every vital, including normal blood pressure, a neutral-format clue so clue presence cannot encode correctness.
Randomize or vary patient values and abnormal rows between attempts while deriving displayed ranges, clues, and validation from the same case data; avoid a stable row-position solution.

Make ASK/EXAM findings materially affect the assessment, such as choosing which measurements need urgent attention or prioritizing the next clinical action based on combined symptoms, examination, and vitals.

Add meaningful visual patient-state/report feedback and a bounded error consequence or information cost. Unlimited retry is not justified while four fixed binary choices can be enumerated and the gather memo leaks the mapping.
Replace the blood-pressure comparator with a clear child-appropriate range or otherwise explain why 128/78 counts as not concerning.
Remove the unused global `.vital-row.off` rule or scope it only to a component that intentionally uses it, reducing the risk of reintroducing gather-phase color leakage.
